subject: HIPAA posture & BAA draft for HealthIQ — controls mapping and evidence request
messages:
From: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@healthiq.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthiq.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@sunrisehealth.org>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP: HIPAA controls + BAA draft (HealthIQ)

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is the RFP section specific to PHI handling and our standard BAA template — we need a concise controls mapping (column per control: Redwood implementation + evidence link) and a draft BAA with your redlines by Friday, 09/24.

A few clarifying questions up front so we can triage:
- Does Redwood ever persist PHI in plaintext logs or telemetry? We need a clear statement and examples of redaction or scrubbing.
- Who is the KMS custodian for customer keys if we enable customer-managed keys for a private deployment? Rotation cadence?
- Retention: default log and trace retention, and whether we can set a 90-day max for HealthIQ.
- Can you provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a point of contact for security evidence collection?

We will share the BAA redlines we expect to propose by EOD Monday. Happy to schedule a 30-min sync early next week — propose Tue 9/21 10:00am PT if that works.

Regards,
Miguel Santos
VP, IT & Procurement
HealthIQ Medical Group

Attachments: HealthIQ_RFP-Questions.pdf, BAA-HealthIQ-Template.docx

From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@healthiq.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: HIPAA controls + BAA draft (HealthIQ)

Miguel — thanks for the clear asks and timeline. We're happy to support HealthIQ and can deliver the mapping + BAA redline by 09/24. Quick answers inline below, and I've attached a controls mapping workbook for your review.

- PHI in logs: Redwood does not intentionally persist PHI in plaintext telemetry. Default behavior is to hash and redact prompt/response tokens that match configured sensitive patterns; request-level metadata (timestamps, model id, request id) is retained. For customers using Private deployment with customer-managed keys, we can additionally enable local log scrubbing at the ingress layer. We will provide sample redaction rules and sanitized log excerpts as evidence.

- KMS custodian: For Hosted accounts Redwood manages envelope keys and stores master keys in our KMS (AWS KMS by default). For Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments we support customer-managed keys (CMK) via customer AWS KMS or HSM — customer remains custodian. Rotation: CMKs follow the customer's KMS policy and we support automated key rotation on a 90-day cadence or as requested.

- Retention: By default, operational logs and traces are retained for 180 days. We can configure HealthIQ to 90 days for logs/trace/metrics in Dedicated/Private deployments via a config flag; Hosted customer can request a contractual retention addendum.

- SOC 2: Latest SOC2 Type II (covering 2025) is attached. Point of contact for evidence collection: marcus.lin@redwood.ai (Security) and rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai (Compliance).

Next steps we propose:
1) We will: (a) finalize controls mapping workbook with evidence links and (b) attach a BAA redline.
2) You: provide your redlines to our BAA (we can import and comment) and confirm whether you need customer-managed keys for initial onboarding.
3) Sync: Tue 9/21 10:00am PT works for us — sending calendar invite.

Attached: Redwood_HIPAA_Controls_Mapping_v1.xlsx, SOC2-Type2-Redwood-2025.pdf

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

--
Note: Samples of sanitized logs can be provided under NDA. For any redaction examples we will replace PHI with hashed tokens and show the retention lifecycle in the mapping workbook.

From: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@healthiq.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthiq.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@sunrisehealth.org>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: HIPAA controls + BAA draft (HealthIQ)

Irene (and team) — thanks for the rapid response and the SOC report. Attaching our markups to the BAA and a short list of follow-ups after an internal review:

1) KMS evidence: Can you provide proof of automated key rotation logs for the last 12 months (timestamps + key IDs) or an alternate attestation?
2) Audit logs: We need a sample (sanitized) audit trail showing who accessed decrypted outputs for a single request, including internal engineer IDs and timestamps.
3) Data residency: Confirm that for Hosted accounts, customer data is stored in regional buckets (we asked for US-only); please confirm the region and whether multi-region replication is enabled by default.

We attached BAA-Redline-HealthIQ.docx (our tracked changes). We'll aim to consolidate and get back by Wed EOD if there are material changes. Also — please confirm whether PHI can be excluded from model telemetry (we might request telemetry opt-out during onboarding).

Regards,
Miguel

Attachments: BAA-Redline-HealthIQ.docx

Subject: Fwd: RFP: HIPAA controls + BAA draft (HealthIQ) — internal action items

Team — forwarding Miguel's latest with attachments. Quick plan:
- Marcus: collect KMS rotation artifacts (we can export CloudTrail + KMS key rotation events) and prepare a 12-month report. Please redact ARNs as necessary and keep PII out of the report.
- Rishi: prepare a sanitized audit trail sample that demonstrates access authorization and the internal role that performed the decrypt. Use a synthetic request id, but include real timestamp cadence and role labels.
- Evelyn: confirm data residency settings for HealthIQ's prospective tenant on Hosted (US-west-2) and whether cross-region replication was enabled historically. Also draft language to offer a contractual data-residency guarantee for a Hosted-to-Dedicated migration path.

I will coordinate with Legal on the BAA redline and respond to HealthIQ with timelines by EOD today. Marcus/Rishi/Evelyn — can you each confirm availability to deliver these artifacts by Thu 9/23? We want to keep to the customer's timeline.

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
